Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
```

Register data with duckdb

```{r echo=FALSE}

con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial FROM core_nightly; LOAD spatial;")

# bekk
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE bekk AS
  SELECT *
  FROM ST_Read('/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/FKB-Vann_Akershus.gpkg', layer = 'fkbvann')
  WHERE objtype = 'ElvBekk'
    AND medium = 'U'
")

# Åker
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE aker AS
    SELECT 
    ST_MakeValid(SHAPE) AS geom,
    * EXCLUDE (SHAPE)
  FROM ST_Read('/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_FKB/Original/FKB-AR5 FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_FKB-AR5_FGDB.gdb', layer='fkb_ar5_omrade')
  WHERE arealtype IN ('21', '22', '23')
    AND arealtype IS NOT NULL
")


#gråareal
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE ga AS
  SELECT ST_Transform(geom, 'EPSG:25833', 'EPSG:25832') AS geom, *
  EXCLUDE geom
  FROM ST_Read('/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/32_25835_graastruktur_gpkg.gpkg', layer='GraaArealFlate')
")

# check that they are correctly registered
dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA table_info('aker')")
dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA table_info('ga')")
dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA table_info('bekk')")

```

Identify bekk segments overlapping åker and gråareal and remove them

```{r echo=FALSE}

# remove areas overlapping åker
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bekk_no_aker AS
  SELECT 
    b.* EXCLUDE (geom),
    CASE 
      WHEN a.geom IS NULL THEN b.geom
      ELSE ST_Difference(b.geom, a.geom)
    END AS geom
  FROM bekk b
  LEFT JOIN aker a
  ON ST_Intersects(b.geom, a.geom)
")

# remove areas overlapping gråareal
dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bekk_clean AS
  SELECT 
    b.* EXCLUDE (geom),
    CASE 
      WHEN g.geom IS NULL THEN b.geom
      ELSE ST_Difference(b.geom, g.geom)
    END AS geom
  FROM bekk_no_aker b
  LEFT JOIN ga g
  ON ST_Intersects(b.geom, g.geom)
")

# read results back into r
bekk_clean_df <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT *, ST_AsWKB(geom) AS geom_wkb
  FROM bekk_clean
")

# convert to geometry
bekk_clean_sf <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT ST_AsWKB(geom) AS geom_wkb, *
  FROM bekk_clean
") %>%
  filter(sapply(geom_wkb, is.raw)) %>%
  mutate(geometry = st_as_sfc(geom_wkb, crs = 25832)) %>%
  select(-geom, -geom_wkb) %>%
  st_sf() %>% 
  st_zm() %>% 
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry))
```

Export

```{r echo=FALSE}

# write to scratch temporarily and copy to P drive
out_gpkg <- "/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/bekkapninger.gpkg"
st_write(bekk_clean_sf, out_gpkg, layer = "bekkapninger")


file.copy(
  from = out_gpkg,
  to = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Kriteriekart/bekkapninger.gpkg",
  overwrite = TRUE)

```
